game: Ratchet & Clank Future: A Crack in Time
approach: Static recompilation of the PPU code to C with ps3recomp and of the SPU programs, HLE system libraries, Direct3D 12 RSX backend; a launcher builds each game on your PC from your own copy
help: Testing on Windows itself (the project's own runs are under Proton on Linux)
Testing on AMD and Intel GPUs
Testing the Linux launcher on more distributions
notes: Early work, not playable. Builds with the 1.20 update; a scripted new game reaches its first level (great_clock_a) and plays its opening cutscenes, in 4 of 4 runs; player control there is not confirmed. The EU and JP 1.20 updates are a different program and are not supported yet. Needs your own copy of the game and the decrypted EBOOT made from it; the launcher builds the game on your PC. The project's own test runs use the Windows program under Proton on Linux (the Linux launcher starts it that way); players have reported results from Windows itself.
